## What changes

## If this is a fix (the four points of CONTRIBUTING.md)

1. **Why it is a defect** (which promise it breaks or what fails, with the steps to see it):
2. **Why it is not a new feature** (where it is promised):
3. **Why it is needed** (who it happens to, in which flow):
4. **What it improves** (what can be done or seen afterwards, in a way that can be checked):

## Checks

- [ ] Formats save every value (nothing omitted or hidden in code).
- [ ] What a user can do can also be done with `reiwand-ctl`; editor features are an `Action`.
- [ ] Documented in `docs/specs` and tested.
- [ ] No comments in code and no file over 200 lines.
- [ ] No personal data in code, files or messages.
